attributes.description:
Sets the ripple effect color that appears when users interact with the carousel (tap or click). This creates a visual feedback animation to indicate user interaction. When transparent, no ripple effect is visible.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-ripple-color

Controls the width of individual carousel slides (the content panels that display images, text, or other content). When set to 100%, each slide takes up the full width of the carousel container. Acceptable units: %, px, em, rem.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-slide-width

Controls the padding (top/bottom, left/right) inside carousel slides. This creates breathing room on the sides of the slide content, preventing content from touching the edges. Acceptable units: px.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-slide-padding

Corner radius for normal (middle) carousel slides.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-slide-border-radius

Border color for normal carousel slides. Transparent hides the outline unless a border width is set with a visible style.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-slide-border-color

Border width for normal carousel slides.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-slide-border-width

Border style for normal carousel slides (e.g. solid, dashed).
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-slide-border-style

Background of normal (non-first, non-last, non-active) carousel slides.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-slide-background

Padding inside the first carousel slide. Defaults match normal slides; theme editors can diverge.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-first-slide-padding

Corner radius for the first carousel slide.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-first-slide-border-radius

Border color for the first carousel slide.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-first-slide-border-color

Border width for the first carousel slide.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-first-slide-border-width

Border style for the first carousel slide.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-first-slide-border-style

Background of the first carousel slide.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-first-slide-background

Padding inside the last carousel slide. Defaults match normal slides; theme editors can diverge.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-last-slide-padding

Corner radius for the last carousel slide.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-last-slide-border-radius

Border color for the last carousel slide.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-last-slide-border-color

Border width for the last carousel slide.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-last-slide-border-width

Border style for the last carousel slide.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-last-slide-border-style

Background of the last carousel slide.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-last-slide-background

Height of the previous-slide control (left arrow). Larger values make the control easier to tap. Acceptable units: px.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-prev-btn-height

Width of the previous-slide control (left arrow). Larger values make the control easier to tap. Acceptable units: px.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-prev-btn-width

Corner radius of the previous-slide button. Use a large value (e.g. 48px) for a circular control.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-prev-btn-border-radius

Border color of the previous-slide button. Transparent hides the outline.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-prev-btn-border-color

Border width of the previous-slide button.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-prev-btn-border-width

Outer spacing on the leading side of the previous-slide button (away from the slide content).
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-prev-btn-margin-left

Icon size for the previous arrow glyph inside the button.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-prev-btn-font-size

Icon color for the previous arrow.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-prev-btn-color

Sets the background color of carousel navigation arrow buttons. When transparent, only the arrow icon is visible. When filled with a color, the buttons appear with a solid background.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-navigation-arrows-background

Ripple color when the previous-slide button is pressed. Transparent disables the ripple.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-prev-btn-ripple-color

Height of the next-slide control (right arrow). Larger values make the control easier to tap. Acceptable units: px.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-next-btn-height

Width of the next-slide control (right arrow). Larger values make the control easier to tap. Acceptable units: px.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-next-btn-width

Corner radius of the next-slide button. Use a large value (e.g. 48px) for a circular control.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-next-btn-border-radius

Border color of the next-slide button. Transparent hides the outline.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-next-btn-border-color

Border width of the next-slide button.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-next-btn-border-width

Spacing used for the next control wrapper (e.g. inset from the trailing edge of the carousel). Often mirrors the previous button spacing.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-next-btn-margin-left

Inner margin on the next-slide button (e.g. space between the button surface and the carousel edge).
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-next-btn-margin-right

Icon size for the next arrow glyph inside the button.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-next-btn-font-size

Icon color for the next arrow.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-next-btn-color

Background of the next-slide button. Transparent shows only the icon.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-next-btn-background

Ripple color when the next-slide button is pressed. Transparent disables the ripple.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-next-btn-ripple-color

Controls the padding (top/bottom, left/right) inside the carousel dots container (the wrapper that holds all the navigation dots). This creates breathing room around the dots. Acceptable units: px.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-dots-wrapper-padding

Sets the background color of the carousel dots container (the wrapper that holds all the navigation dots). When transparent, only the dots are visible. When filled with a color, the container appears with a colored background.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-dots-wrapper-background-color

Controls the overall transparency of the carousel dots container (the wrapper that holds all the navigation dots). When set to 1, the container is fully opaque. Lower values make it more transparent.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-dots-wrapper-opacity

Controls the width of carousel indicators (the small dots at the bottom that show which slide is active). These dots help users navigate between different slides in the carousel. Larger values make the dots more prominent and easier to tap. Acceptable units: px.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-dots-width

Controls the height of carousel indicators (the small dots at the bottom that show which slide is active). These dots help users navigate between different slides in the carousel. Larger values make the dots more prominent and easier to tap. Acceptable units: px.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-dots-height

Sets the border color of carousel indicators (the navigation dots). These dots help users navigate between different slides in the carousel. This determines what color the border around each dot appears in.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-dots-border-color

Controls the corner rounding of carousel indicators (the navigation dots). When set to 5px, the indicators appear as rounded dots. Other values create different levels of rounding. When set to circle, the indicators appear as perfect round dots.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-dots-border-radius

Controls the thickness of the border around carousel indicators (the navigation dots). This creates the outline effect around each navigation dot.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-dots-border-width

Sets the background color of carousel indicators (the navigation dots). When transparent, only the border is visible. When filled, the dot appears solid.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-dots-background

Controls the margin (top/bottom, left/right) of carousel indicators (navigation dots). This creates visual separation between each dot. Acceptable units: px.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-dots-margin

Controls the transparency of inactive carousel indicators (navigation dots). When set to 0.6, the dots appear semi-transparent to indicate they are not the currently active slide. This creates a visual hierarchy that helps users understand their current position.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-dots-opacity

Sets the background color of the currently active carousel indicator (the dot representing the slide that is currently being displayed). This creates visual feedback to show users which slide they are viewing.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-dots-background

Controls the transparency of the active carousel indicator. When set to 1, the active dot is fully opaque, making it stand out from inactive dots. This creates a visual hierarchy that helps users understand their current position.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-dots-opacity

Controls the width of the active carousel indicators (the small dots at the bottom that show which slide is active). These dots help users navigate between different slides in the carousel. Larger values make the dots more prominent and easier to tap. Acceptable units: px.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-dots-width

Controls the height of active carousel indicators (the small dots at the bottom that show which slide is active). These dots help users navigate between different slides in the carousel. Larger values make the dots more prominent and easier to tap. Acceptable units: px.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-dots-height

Sets the border color of the active carousel indicators (the navigation dots). These dots help users navigate between different slides in the carousel. This determines what color the border around each dot appears in.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-dots-border-color

Controls the corner rounding of the active carousel indicators (the navigation dots). When set to 5px, the indicators appear as rounded dots. Other values create different levels of rounding. When set to circle, the indicators appear as perfect round dots.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-dots-border-radius

Controls the thickness of the border around the active carousel indicators (the navigation dots). This creates the outline effect around each navigation dot.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-dots-border-width

Controls the margin (top/bottom, left/right) of active carousel indicators (navigation dots). This creates visual separation between each dot. Acceptable units: px.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-dots-margin

Width override for the active carousel slide. Match the keys under mapping.slide; use the same CSS variable names so the active selector block overrides :root defaults.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-slide-width

Padding inside the active carousel slide. Mirrors mapping.slide.padding.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-slide-padding

Border radius for the active carousel slide. Mirrors mapping.slide.border.radius.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-slide-border-radius

Border color for the active carousel slide. Mirrors mapping.slide.border.color.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-slide-border-color

Border width for the active carousel slide. Mirrors mapping.slide.border.width.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-slide-border-width

Border style for the active carousel slide. Mirrors mapping.slide.border.style.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-slide-border-style

Background for the active carousel slide. Mirrors mapping.slide.background.
CSS variable: --wm-carousel-slide-background
